nodes.description: Pure helper safeAdd(uint a, uint b) that computes c = a + b and requires c >= a to prevent overflow.
Pure helper safeSub(uint a, uint b) that requires b <= a before computing c = a - b, preventing underflow.
Pure helper safeMul(uint a, uint b) that computes c = a * b and requires a == 0 || c / a == b to prevent overflow.
Pure helper safeDiv(uint a, uint b) that requires b > 0 before computing c = a / b.
Constructor of Owned that assigns owner = msg.sender at deployment time.
Ownership handover step guarded by onlyOwner; writes newOwner = _newOwner.
Ownership handover step requiring msg.sender == newOwner, then moves owner to newOwner and zeroes newOwner.
Constructor of the token contract that sets symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and pre-funds the deployer address.
Constant function returning _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with a raw (unchecked) subtraction.
Constant function returning balances[tokenOwner].
ERC20 transfer that debits balances[msg.sender] via safeSub and credits balances[to] via safeAdd.
ERC20 approve that writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
ERC20 transferFrom that debits balances[from], decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] and credits balances[to].
Constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts to reject ETH.
Only-owner function that calls transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary token contract address.
Public address state variable holding the current contract owner.
Public address state variable holding the pending owner during the two-step handover.
Public string state variable holding the token symbol (STR).
Public string state variable holding the token name (Sterilium Token).
Public uint8 state variable holding the token decimals (18).
Public uint state variable holding the total token supply.
Mapping(address => uint) holding the token balance of each account.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) holding ERC20 allowances.
Caller-supplied address used for owner assignment, the onlyOwner check and acceptOwnership authorisation.
Caller-supplied address used as the debit account and allowance key in token operations.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) on an unvalidated spender contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary, unvalidated token contract.
Raw subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] performed without SafeMath, a potential arithmetic underflow site.
Multiplication a * b in safeMul; guarded by the c / a == b post-condition check.
Parameter 'to' of SteriliumToken.transfer, the credit destination.
Parameter 'tokens' of SteriliumToken.transfer, the amount moved.
Parameter 'spender' of SteriliumToken.approve, the allowance beneficiary.
Parameter 'tokens' of SteriliumToken.approve, the allowance amount.
Parameter 'from' of SteriliumToken.transferFrom, the debited account.
Parameter 'to' of SteriliumToken.transferFrom, the credited account.
Parameter 'tokens' of SteriliumToken.transferFrom, the amount moved.
Parameter 'spender' of SteriliumToken.approveAndCall, the contract whose receiveApproval is invoked.
Parameter 'data' of SteriliumToken.approveAndCall, forwarded calldata to the spender.
Parameter 'tokenAddress' of transferAnyERC20Token, the arbitrary token contract target.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferAnyERC20Token, the amount forwarded to the token contract.
Parameter '_newOwner' of Owned.transferOwnership, the pending owner address.
Local return variable 'c' in safeAdd holding the addition result.
Local return variable 'c' in safeSub holding the subtraction result.

edges.reason: The Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, giving the deployer privileged control.
acceptOwnership authorises the state change with require(msg.sender == newOwner).
The onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender to owner before allowing transferOwnership.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted by onlyOwner, which checks msg.sender against owner.
transfer debits the caller-controlled balances[msg.sender] entry.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller address as key.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller address as spender.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callee.
transferOwnership stages the privileged owner state variable.
acceptOwnership commits the privileged owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner address.
acceptOwnership reads and compares newOwner to msg.sender before promoting it.
transferAnyERC20Token routes recovered tokens to the stored owner address.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] for the burn-adjusted supply.
balanceOf returns the caller-indexed balances mapping entry.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping for from and to.
The constructor pre-funds balances of the fixed distribution address.
approve writes the allowed nested mapping.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowed nested mapping.
allowance reads the allowed nested mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed nested mapping before the external call.
The constructor sets the _totalSupply state variable.
The constructor sets the symbol state variable.
The constructor sets the name state variable.
The constructor sets the decimals state variable.
transfer relies on SafeMath.safeSub to prevent balance underflow.
transfer relies on SafeMath.safeAdd to prevent balance overflow.
transferFrom relies on safeSub for balance and allowance decrements.
transferFrom relies on safeAdd for the recipient credit.
safeMul performs the integer multiplication whose overflow is checked after the fact.
totalSupply performs a raw subtraction without SafeMath, allowing potential underflow.
approveAndCall transfers control to the untrusted spender contract via receiveApproval.
The receiveApproval callback can re-enter transfer while the outer call is executing.
transferAnyERC20Token makes an external call into an arbitrary token contract.
The untrusted token contract can re-enter the owner-privileged function during the external call.
The two-step ownership handover requires transferOwnership to precede acceptOwnership.
The 'to' parameter is the credit destination used by transfer.
The 'tokens' parameter is the amount moved by transfer.
The 'spender' parameter keys the allowance written by approve.
The 'tokens' parameter is the allowance amount written by approve.
The 'from' parameter is the debited account used by transferFrom.
The 'to' parameter is the credited account used by transferFrom.
The 'tokens' parameter is the amount moved by transferFrom.
The 'spender' parameter keys the allowance and is the callback target of approveAndCall.
The 'data' parameter is forwarded verbatim to the external receiveApproval callback.
The 'tokenAddress' parameter selects the arbitrary contract called by transferAnyERC20Token.
The 'tokens' parameter is the amount forwarded to the external token contract.
The '_newOwner' parameter is written into the pending newOwner slot.
The local 'c' in safeAdd holds the result of the guarded addition.
The local 'c' in safeSub holds the result of the guarded subtraction.
The 'spender' parameter directly determines the external contract invoked in the callback.
The 'tokenAddress' parameter directly determines the external contract invoked.
